conditions.workload: Fixed ceil(seconds/feed_period) rounds; delayed rounds are retained and actual duration reported

measurement.clock: One Python observer time.monotonic(); all event times are seconds since run start
measurement.e2e: Actual source capability acceptance -> actual target capability extraction; each event lies within its RCON request/reply interval. Bounds are not world-save times.
measurement.polling: Low-flow completion includes target polling cadence; output is not observed until an actual pull succeeds.
measurement.db_transactions: Sum of cumulative ct_test status db_transactions differences on A/B/C; includes controls, heartbeat/permission refresh and ambient loaded devices, excludes observer root SQL.
measurement.sql_statement_events: performance_schema account summary WHERE USER='ct_dev', statement/sql/* events only; counts attempts including retries, not JDBC round trips. Account-wide, including any running perf JVM.
measurement.wal: Not measured on unmodified baseline: no WAL timing/count instrumentation exists.
measurement.conservation: Accepted FE = actual extracted FE after drain; local buffers and SQL residue checked empty independently. SQL transfer remaining and local/WAL copies are never added together.
measurement.steady_e2e: Aggregate throughput/fairness only: overlapped FE inputs have no packet identity; no invented per-input steady latency.
measurement.fixture: Fresh console-owned blocks, vanilla chunk load tickets; no online-player, GUI, machine-container or injected network-latency claim.

measurement.CPU: /proc/PID/stat utime+stime; process percent has one CPU at 100%, may exceed 100%
measurement.RSS: Linux process resident memory; includes heap, native allocations, code and mappings
measurement.heap: jstat -gc observed region capacities/usages; excludes metaspace/CCS; samples, not allocation rate
measurement.GC: jstat cumulative GC count/time deltas; times are elapsed seconds, not tick time or pause distribution
measurement.jstat_raw: Both -gc and -gcutil raw stdout preserved with independent read intervals
measurement.MSPT: Not measured. No full-server JFR, tick instrumentation or stop-the-world pause claim.
measurement.sidecar: Read-only observer creates short jstat processes; match its sampling before/after.

coverage.note: Baseline third repeat tail only; earlier repeats MC tick data UNMEASURED
coverage.policy: Only actual query intervals recorded here are covered. No backfill from later samples.

measurement.window: Arithmetic mean of latest min(100,max(tickCount,1)) recorded ticks, normally latest 100
measurement.scope: tickServer elapsed work through tally; includes ServerTickEvent.Pre, worlds and autosave; excludes NeoForge ServerTickEvent.Post and idle/other outer-loop work
measurement.percentiles: Vanilla tick query sorted 100-slot tickTimesNanos window; not phase-wide percentiles
measurement.console_rounding: TickCommand.nanosToMilisString formats one decimal ms; approximately +/-0.05ms rounding
measurement.target_tickrate: Configured TickRateManager.tickrate(); not measured actual or instantaneous TPS
measurement.whole_loop_MSPT: UNMEASURED: full-loop/full-extension tick wall time not instrumented
measurement.observer: Concurrent read-only tick query per JVM; request/reply intervals preserved. No JVM nanoTime subtraction.

method.source: JSON reports only; source snapshot SHA256 includes incomplete/failed reports.
method.alignment: Benchmark has only second-resolution UTC start, not an absolute monotonic anchor. Align observer UTC with run-relative events; no cross-JVM nanoTime arithmetic. Clock margin is an explicit approximation, not proof of an exact phase origin.
method.boundary_guard: Include complete read intervals only, with clock margin on both sides. CPU interval ends before jstat starts; heap/GC uses -gc interval; tick uses RCON request/reply interval.
method.matching: Same scenario/repeat/phase and fixed requested input count/FE. Intersect actual sampled coverage, round inward to common real input boundaries. Low-flow progress follows actual probe inputs, not elapsed-duration percentages.
method.counters: CPU/GC deltas use only first/last real contained samples per run, so actual windows can be shorter than the common requested slice. Actual windows and refs retained; no interpolation/extrapolation.
method.heap_tick_coverage: A hull of sample times is not continuous coverage. Tick window age has no measured wall-time bound; no complete-phase or whole-loop MSPT / actual-TPS claim.
method.WAL: Baseline WAL count/time UNMEASURED. Instrumented C-B differences may be measured separately; no baseline zero implied.
method.baseline_scale1000_idle: Previously observed independent 118.000200710s / 862 DBtx = 7.30507232033 tx/s; not the entire 120s phase and not derived from this sidecar summary.
